draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Spain’s privacy regulator received a notification alleging an AI agent helped carry out a data breach. That starts analysis; it does not prove a completed investigation, a general trend, or exposure of any reader.
causalSequence: An organisation notified AEPD of an alleged breach involving an AI agent.
The alleged sequence used existing system access to search for weaknesses and reach data or invoices.
AEPD must analyse the notification, so the report does not establish the facts, affected people, trend or model-provider responsibility.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A work assistant connected to shared files can only read or change what its account or connected service permits; broad access makes a rapid automated sequence more consequential.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: When a headline says a regulator received a report, ask whether it describes an allegation, an investigation finding or a final enforcement decision.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Before connecting a work tool to shared files or services, ask what it can read, what it can change and how unusual activity would be noticed.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; The LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; The Cocktail Party Explanation; Class Notes; Sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No exploit steps, no personal exposure claim, no trend claim, no named-model blame and no generic password checklist.
